data.name: Copy the file to your AnduinOS computer, then open Offline Updater in Settings and choose the file. The app will check compatibility before you start.
data.value: 将更新包复制到你的 AnduinOS 电脑，在“设置”中打开“离线更新器”并选择文件。应用会先检查兼容性，再开始更新。

data.name: Download here. Open in Offline Updater. Update without an Internet connection.
data.value: 在这里下载更新包，用离线更新器打开，无需联网即可更新。

data.name: Each package is cumulative. You do not need to download every earlier update.
data.value: 每个更新包都是累积式的。您无需下载之前所有的更新。

data.name: Offline update packages will appear here when they are ready.
data.value: 离线更新包准备好后会显示在此处。

data.name: Package details and earlier downloads
data.value: 更新包详情与历史版本

data.name: Stay up to date. Even offline.
Your next update is on its way.
